title: What It Actually Looks Like to Ask for Help and Still Be the Strong One
caption:
Galatians 6:2: "Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ."

Nobody was ever meant to carry it alone. The strong man isn't the one who needs no one. He's the one who texts first.

Send this to a brother who's been quiet lately.

#faith #brotherhood #godlyman #galatians
